brief:
Israeli occupation bulldozers demolished a car showroom in Hazma, a village northeast of occupied Jerusalem, the Ma'an news agency reported. The demolition was carried out without prior notice to the owners.

The incident marks the latest in a series of structure demolitions in Palestinian communities near Jerusalem, where Israeli authorities frequently cite lack of building permits as justification for removals.
title: Israeli bulldozers demolish car dealership in Hazma village near Jerusalem
